Why do many Hindus convert to Christianity ?
In this thought-provoking video, we delve into the recent phenomenon of a significant number of Hindus converting to Christianity in India. With 1 Lakh (100,000) conversions occurring in just one week, the dynamics at play are both intriguing and complex.
Join us as we explore the factors contributing to this trend and aim to shed light on the motivations behind Hindu individuals embracing the Christian faith. We take an in-depth look at the role of Christian missionaries in India, their methods, and the impact they have on local communities.
